notes.title: Major Epica Update 3.0
notes.content:
Today we release the Epica 3.0 beta client. 

[h3]Overview[/h3]
The 3.0 Epica Build features the following:
[list]
    [*]Re-introduces the 3D player and world view
    [*]New game world design
    [*]New interface design
    [*]Ladder Reset
    [*]Game code prepared for multiplayer
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39219211/6a6400088b4a2afc836b81afaee80cd53e5f22b7.png[/img]

[h3]General Notes[/h3]
The new game world is still being worked on, with more quests, NPCs, and balancing. Naerock the name of the game world in Epica is now divided into different Acts, instead of a single big level. 

Though, this new release is only playable in the starting zone. Upcoming patches will introduce more quests and open more game regions. 

The ladder was reset for the first time, you can still access the previous ladder rankings via the ladder panel menu.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39219211/02589d329bcaa7a4caeef404e26db475bffc2882.png[/img]

[h3]Upcoming[/h3] 
The main focus is currently on tweaking existing content, including balancing and character progression, and to populate Act 1 with more content. Additional the following features will be rolled out soon:

[list]
    [*]Swimming
    [*]The multiplayer test server 
[/list]

Even though a top down version was introduced earlier this year, the new build goes back to the original 3rd person view and in addition the plan is to add a multiplayer mode.

This build has been published to introduce the new game focus, and the plan is to enable multiplayer in January. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39219211/c443f508d47c36cc7ced298c3604f1ad42ff1794.gif[/img]

[h1]Current Features[/h1]
Current features are basic and will be further tweaked. There is the starting zone with two towns and a castle has been setup. The player inventory can be opened by pressing the "i" key. This also brings up the  cursor - enabling pickup. Interacting with vendors or quest givers can be done by pressing the "e" key.

Further there is the combat system, pressing the left mouse button will draw the current weapon. Though, there are many aspects not yet fully integrated, for instance other weapons beside the default axe. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39219211/944aa0df93b9f2ec1c41e351d69ee9cb08690cd8.gif[/img]

Next updates will add more detail to the starting zone, including more NPCs, quests, swimming, the crafting system, and much more.

For the latest follow us at https://twitter.com/playEpica

notes.title: Major Content Patch
notes.content:
After about three months of careful considerations the new beta client 1.1 has been released to the Steam Epica live servers. This patch introduces a major change, many parts of the game are now setup for a top-down player perspective, but not all.

[h2]Summary[/h2]

[list]
[*] New runtime created dungeon, ‘Lordenfels’
[*] New player base character
[*] Lots of new gear items
[*] Ladder reset
[*] New ‘top-down’ game world
[*] And ofc, lots of bug fixes and tweaks
[/list]

[previewyoutube=XPkKBkJ6jI8;full][/previewyoutube]

The top-down approach now helps to fast pace the development of Epica, since it reduces the workload considerable. The new world already contains many parts of Epica, specifically the Naerocks region.

Another major change patch 1.1 introduces is for player characters, a new player character setup now better blends gear items. Though, older items may still be not fully compatible with the new method. This will be addressed later this year, when we introduce a re-worked character editor for customizations.

[h2]New Procedural Dungeon Lordenfels[/h2]
Players may remember the first procedural dungeon, there is now an upgrade, for an idea take a look at this gameplay screenshot.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39219211/8624ea0cabc1ed6d09f572332c0459c22ca3d0aa.png[/img]

[h2]State of Epica[/h2]
This release is a focus to bring you the long awaited update. However, because of the scale of changes and new content the current game – while playable, is still needing a few more weeks until the Naerocks region has been flashed-out. There are several zones setup, and two dungeons,

In addition to improving the fidelity of the level designs, quests, and encounters need more attention. Another important aspect is in regard to the loot, the new loot is so far not much tweaked.

This game version targets again Epica Early Access owners. With the new game world approach content updates and the content progression will likely accelerate.

Thank you for following us on social media, and playtesting the game.

notes.title: Now Live: Beta Patch 0.1.5
notes.content:
[h2]Updates[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added a welcome info panel
[*] Disabled auto rotate camera on spawn.
[*] Added keybinding for drawing weapon
[*] Added keybinding movement speed
[*] Addressed known issue of weapon not rendered, and lobby camera position.
[/list]


[h2]Welcome Panel[/h2]
The Herold of Naerocks is now on display when starting to play, a panel with brief information of important keybindings, and news.

To improve the experience for new players in the next patch we will add a special NPC to the starting zone, welcoming the player and offering a starter quest.

Per default the player is now invisible, but appears once the player starts to move.

[h2]New Keybindings[/h2]
Added the keybindings for drawing the currently equipped weapon (and shield if there is one), to the settings for keys.

Added the keybinding for switching between movement modes, mainly walking or running. Thanks to user dugalm who brought this to my attention.

[h2]Known Issues[/h2]
For a current overview of issues we now also have a dedicated discussion, found [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1281480/discussions/0/2992043384043479212/]here[/url]. There have been some changes to address rendering of the equipped weapon, perhaps this has been fixed, we still investigate this.

[h2]Other Changes[/h2]
Initial loading of the world should be now more accurate, meaning the loading bar may be only briefly or a bit longer visible, depending on loading of the starting zone.

Generally the starting zone is apparently one of the game regions with more content, since everything is in close proximity on the island. Additional, content is not yet fully optimized for best performances.

[h2]How to Update[/h2]
Steam may update your client immediately, otherwise restart Steam.

notes.content:
[h2]Updates[/h2]

The past two weeks were spent migrating the player stored data from Amazon Gamesparks to Epic Online Services. The problem is now that only the developer can login (unless you grant manual access), since the game is not yet reviewed by Epic Games. 

So while here works everything as intended with the user authentication it isn't for the community. Luckily, the data storage solution is setup do work without authentication, which will possibly become a feature in the future. 

Login is needed to keep track of rankings for the ladder, storing player data, adding achievements, and so on.
